item.title: Like father, like son: Lucas Ramirez hits 2 homers for Brazil in WBC with dad Manny Ramirez watching
item.description: HOUSTON (AP) — Manny Ramirez hit plenty of home runs in his 19-year major league career — 555, to be exact.

item.title: Canadians Mboko, Auger-Aliassime, Shapovalov advance at Indian Wells tennis tourney
item.description: INDIAN WELLS — Canada's Victoria Mboko is on to the third round of the Indian Wells tournament. The 19-year-old from Toronto defeated Australia's Kimberly Birrell 6-4, 7-6 (5) on Friday in second-round women's singles tennis action.

item.title: Thomas' 2nd goal of the game leads Blues to a 3-2 overtime win over Sharks
item.description: SAN JOSE, Calif. (AP) — Robert Thomas scored his second goal of the game 54 seconds into overtime and the St. Louis Blues beat the San Jose Sharks 3-2 on Friday night, just hours after trading captain Brayden Schenn .

item.title: Wild back Gustavsson with a 2nd-period burst in a 4-2 victory over the Golden Knights
item.description: LAS VEGAS (AP) — Filip Gustavsson made 30 saves and the Minnesota Wild scored three goals in a 3:07 span in the second period in a 4-2 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Friday night.

item.title: 4 dead in Michigan as powerful storms that produced at least 1 tornado rip through the state
item.description: Four people were killed Friday in southern Michigan as powerful storms that produced at least one tornado reduced homes to rubble, sent parts of roofs flying into the air and left a trail of debris hanging from power lines.

item.title: Stuart Fairchild's grand slam leads Taiwan over Czech Republic at the World Baseball Classic
item.description: Stuart Fairchild's second-inning grand slam powered Taiwan to a 14-0 victory over the Czech Republic on Saturday at the World Baseball Classic.

item.title: NHL roundup: Avalanche beat Stars 5-4 in shootout, halting Dallas’ 10-game win streak
item.description: DALLAS (AP) — Valeri Nichushkin scored with 15 seconds remaining in regulation, then connected on one of NHL-leading Colorado’s two goals in a shootout to beat Dallas 5-4 on Friday night, ending the Stars’ franchise-record winning streak at 10 games.

item.title: Luka Doncic scores 44 points in 3 quarters to lead Lakers past Pacers 128-117 without LeBron
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Luka Doncic scored 44 points in the first three quarters Friday night, overcoming LeBron James' absence and leading the Los Angeles Lakers to a 128-117 victory over the Indiana Pacers.

item.title: Tyler Herro erupts for 35 as the Heat snap the Hornets’ 6-game streak, 128-120
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. (AP) — Tyler Herro had 35 points, nine rebounds and nine assists and the Miami Heat snapped the Charlotte Hornets’ six-game winning streak with a 128-120 victory Friday night.
